1001.title: The motor command could not be used
1001.impact: The controller reported an internal problem.
steps: Stop using motion controls and open Details.
When the hand is safe, restart the controller and reconnect.
If it happens again, save the session log for support.

1002.title: Motor locations are not known yet
1002.impact: Reliable feedback is needed before these motors can be controlled.
steps: Check motor power and the affected bus connections.
Wait for the affected motors to show Online, then retry the original action.

1003.title: Two motors are using the same ID
1003.impact: A unique motor address is required before control can start.
steps: Open Renumber Motor and inspect the reported bus and ID.
Assign unique IDs using the existing maintenance procedure, then scan again.

1004.title: Too many motors are connected to one bus
1004.impact: The affected bus has more motors than its configured capacity.
steps: Open Details to check the affected bus and allowed count.
Move extra motors to another bus, then scan again.

1005.title: Stop is still active
1005.impact: Motion requests are blocked while Stop remains active.
steps: Check that the hand is clear of obstacles.
Retry the action.

1006.title: Another task controls the motors
1006.impact: The controller did not accept this request in its current state.
steps: Wait for the current action or mode change to finish.
If the app remains busy, click Stop, then retry Enable.

1007.title: This action is not available in the current mode
1007.impact: The controller did not accept this request in its current state.
steps: Wait for the current action or mode change to finish.
If the app remains busy, click Stop, then retry Enable.

1008.title: Motor feedback is unavailable
1008.impact: Reliable feedback is needed before these motors can be controlled.
steps: Check motor power and the affected bus connections.
Wait for the affected motors to show Online, then retry the original action.

1009.title: Motor positions need to be recovered
1009.impact: The controller cannot safely interpret the affected motor positions.
steps: Wait for position recovery to finish.
If recovery fails, open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

1010.title: The motor command arrived too late
1010.impact: The controller did not accept this request in its current state.
steps: Wait for the current action or mode change to finish.
If the app remains busy, click Stop, then retry Enable.

1012.title: The requested motor position is outside the hardware limit
1012.impact: The motor command was rejected because it exceeded the hardware travel limit.
steps: Stop motion and check the affected motor position in Details.
Check the saved motor position and calibration before sending another target.

1013.title: A motor has reached its position safety limit
1013.impact: A motor position safety limit is blocking further control.
steps: Check that the affected joint and tendons can move freely.
If Stop is active, check the hand and retry the action.
Open Motor Calibration, select the affected joints, and calibrate them again.

2001.title: Joint feedback is unavailable
2001.impact: The controller cannot use the affected joint position readings.
steps: Check the S3 sensor board and its power and CAN connections.
Wait for current joint readings to return before enabling control.

2002.title: The controller could not identify a joint
2002.impact: The controller reported an internal problem.
steps: Stop using motion controls and open Details.
When the hand is safe, restart the controller and reconnect.
If it happens again, save the session log for support.

2003.title: A joint position sensor is not working reliably
2003.impact: The controller cannot use the affected joint position readings.
steps: Check the S3 sensor board and its power and CAN connections.
Wait for current joint readings to return before enabling control.

2004.title: A joint angle could not be calculated
2004.impact: The selected joints are not ready for this action.
steps: Open Joint Calibration and check the selected joints' Manual Min and Max.
Open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

2005.title: Joint movement has been paused
2005.impact: The joint did not move as expected. Contact with an object is one possible cause.
steps: Check whether the hand is touching an object or a joint is blocked.
When it is safe, send a target in the reverse direction to release the existing hold.

2006.title: A motor target has reached its configured limit
2006.impact: The controller limited a motor target to its applied calibration boundary.
steps: Check the requested target angle and the affected joint.
If ordinary targets keep reaching this limit, check calibration before continuing.

2007.title: A requested angle was limited to the allowed range
2007.impact: The controller limited a requested joint angle to its allowed range.
steps: Check the requested target angle and the affected joint.
If ordinary targets keep reaching this limit, check calibration before continuing.

2008.title: A joint moved beyond its calibrated warning boundary
2008.impact: The measured joint angle exceeded its warning boundary. This warning alone does not stop motion.
steps: Check the requested target angle and the affected joint.
If ordinary targets keep reaching this limit, check calibration before continuing.

2009.title: A reconnected motor is being held in position
2009.impact: The reconnected motor is held until a new target is explicitly sent.
steps: Check that position recovery completed and the hand is clear.
Send a new target using the existing control.

3001.title: The controller lost contact with the app
3001.impact: The control connection was lost and a protective response was triggered.
steps: Check the app and USB connection, then reconnect.
Check the hand and clear any remaining fault before enabling again.

3002.title: The controller cannot start this action yet
3002.impact: The controller did not accept this request in its current state.
steps: Wait for the current action or mode change to finish.
If the app remains busy, click Stop, then retry Enable.

3101.title: Direct Control cannot start in the current state
3101.impact: The controller did not accept this request in its current state.
steps: Wait for the current action or mode change to finish.
If the app remains busy, click Stop, then retry Enable.

3102.title: Selected motors are not ready
3102.impact: Reliable feedback is needed before these motors can be controlled.
steps: Check motor power and the affected bus connections.
Wait for the affected motors to show Online, then retry the original action.

3103.title: Selected motor positions need to be recovered
3103.impact: The controller cannot safely interpret the affected motor positions.
steps: Wait for position recovery to finish.
If recovery fails, open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

3104.title: The controller is busy handling earlier requests
3104.impact: The controller did not accept this request in its current state.
steps: Wait for the current action or mode change to finish.
If the app remains busy, click Stop, then retry Enable.

3105.title: This Direct Control request is no longer current
3105.impact: The controller did not accept this request in its current state.
steps: Wait for the current action or mode change to finish.
If the app remains busy, click Stop, then retry Enable.

3106.title: A device fault is blocking Direct Control
3106.impact: A device fault is blocking this action.
steps: Open Diagnostics and resolve the current fault shown for the affected device.
After correcting the cause, retry Enable.

3201.title: Selected joints need Manual Min and Max values
3201.impact: The selected joints are not ready for this action.
steps: Open Joint Calibration and check the selected joints' Manual Min and Max.
Open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

3202.title: Feedback Control cannot start in the current state
3202.impact: The controller did not accept this request in its current state.
steps: Wait for the current action or mode change to finish.
If the app remains busy, click Stop, then retry Enable.

3203.title: Selected joints are outside the starting range
3203.impact: The selected joints are outside the range required to start joint control.
steps: Check that the hand can move freely.
Use the existing Enable flow to return the selected joints to the starting range.

3204.title: Selected motor positions need to be recovered
3204.impact: The controller cannot safely interpret the affected motor positions.
steps: Wait for position recovery to finish.
If recovery fails, open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

3206.title: The controller is still changing control mode
3206.impact: The controller did not accept this request in its current state.
steps: Wait for the current action or mode change to finish.
If the app remains busy, click Stop, then retry Enable.

3207.title: The controller is busy handling earlier requests
3207.impact: The controller did not accept this request in its current state.
steps: Wait for the current action or mode change to finish.
If the app remains busy, click Stop, then retry Enable.

3301.title: Joint feedback mode is not selected
3301.impact: Joint-feedback readiness does not apply while another control mode is selected.
steps: Select Feedback Control when you want to control joint angles.

3302.title: Motor positions are not ready for joint control
3302.impact: The controller cannot safely interpret the affected motor positions.
steps: Wait for position recovery to finish.
If recovery fails, open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

3303.title: No joints are selected
3303.impact: This action needs at least one selected joint.
steps: Select the joints you want to use, then retry the action.

3304.title: Current joint angles are unavailable
3304.impact: The controller cannot use the affected joint position readings.
steps: Check the S3 sensor board and its power and CAN connections.
Wait for current joint readings to return before enabling control.

3305.title: Selected joints need calibration data
3305.impact: The selected joints are not ready for this action.
steps: Open Joint Calibration and check the selected joints' Manual Min and Max.
Open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

3306.title: A current joint angle is invalid
3306.impact: The controller cannot use the affected joint position readings.
steps: Check the S3 sensor board and its power and CAN connections.
Wait for current joint readings to return before enabling control.

3307.title: A joint is below its starting range
3307.impact: The selected joints are outside the range required to start joint control.
steps: Check that the hand can move freely.
Use the existing Enable flow to return the selected joints to the starting range.

3308.title: Joint calibration no longer matches its Manual endpoints
3308.impact: The selected joints are not ready for this action.
steps: Open Joint Calibration and check the selected joints' Manual Min and Max.
Open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

3309.title: Joint position feedback is unavailable
3309.impact: The controller cannot use the affected joint position readings.
steps: Check the S3 sensor board and its power and CAN connections.
Wait for current joint readings to return before enabling control.

3310.title: A device fault is preventing the Ready state
3310.impact: A device fault is blocking this action.
steps: Open Diagnostics and resolve the current fault shown for the affected device.
After correcting the cause, retry Enable.

3311.title: A motor position safety limit is preventing control
3311.impact: A motor position safety limit is blocking further control.
steps: Check that the affected joint and tendons can move freely.
If Stop is active, check the hand and retry the action.
Open Motor Calibration, select the affected joints, and calibrate them again.

3401.title: Return to the starting range took too long
3401.impact: The return action did not finish within its time limit. The final joint position is not confirmed.
steps: Check for an obstruction or a joint that cannot move freely.
Check that live motor and joint position readings update.
Correct the observed problem before trying Enable again.

3402.title: Position updates stopped during the return movement
3402.impact: The controller cannot use the affected joint position readings.
steps: Check the S3 sensor board and its power and CAN connections.
Wait for current joint readings to return before enabling control.

3403.title: A motor stopped responding during the return movement
3403.impact: Reliable feedback is needed before these motors can be controlled.
steps: Check motor power and the affected bus connections.
Wait for the affected motors to show Online, then retry the original action.

3404.title: Motor positions became uncertain during the return movement
3404.impact: The controller cannot safely interpret the affected motor positions.
steps: Wait for position recovery to finish.
If recovery fails, open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

3405.title: The return movement needs Manual endpoints
3405.impact: The selected joints are not ready for this action.
steps: Open Joint Calibration and check the selected joints' Manual Min and Max.
Open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

3406.title: The return movement needs motor calibration
3406.impact: The selected joints are not ready for this action.
steps: Open Joint Calibration and check the selected joints' Manual Min and Max.
Open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

3407.title: The controller could not send the return target
3407.impact: The controller reported an internal problem.
steps: Stop using motion controls and open Details.
When the hand is safe, restart the controller and reconnect.
If it happens again, save the session log for support.

3408.title: A device fault interrupted the return movement
3408.impact: A device fault is blocking this action.
steps: Open Diagnostics and resolve the current fault shown for the affected device.
After correcting the cause, retry Enable.

3409.title: The return movement was cancelled
3409.impact: The return movement ended before completion.
steps: Check the selected mode and start the intended action again when ready.

3501.title: The joint sensor board is not responding reliably
3501.impact: The controller cannot use the affected joint position readings.
steps: Check the S3 sensor board and its power and CAN connections.
Wait for current joint readings to return before enabling control.

3502.title: A motor load safety limit was reached
steps: Check for an obstruction, a tight tendon, or a joint that cannot move freely.
After correcting the cause, retry the original action.

3503.title: Motor feedback is unavailable
3503.impact: Reliable feedback is needed before these motors can be controlled.
steps: Check motor power and the affected bus connections.
Wait for the affected motors to show Online, then retry the original action.

3505.title: Motor positions are not trusted
3505.impact: The controller cannot safely interpret the affected motor positions.
steps: Wait for position recovery to finish.
If recovery fails, open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

4101.title: A joint did not return far enough during calibration
4101.impact: Calibration found a possible assembly or travel issue. This does not identify a mechanical cause.
steps: Check tendon routing, preload, and the affected joint's ability to move freely.
Correct the observed issue, then calibrate that joint again.

4102.title: A joint did not reach far enough during calibration
4102.impact: Calibration found a possible assembly or travel issue. This does not identify a mechanical cause.
steps: Check tendon routing, preload, and the affected joint's ability to move freely.
Correct the observed issue, then calibrate that joint again.

4103.title: Measured joint travel differs from the model
4103.impact: Calibration found a possible assembly or travel issue. This does not identify a mechanical cause.
steps: Check tendon routing, preload, and the affected joint's ability to move freely.
Correct the observed issue, then calibrate that joint again.

6001.title: The controller could not start the sensor connection
6001.impact: A communication update was incomplete or invalid.
steps: Check the affected connection and confirm that the app and firmware versions match.
If the problem continues, open Details and save the session log.

6002.title: A sensor message could not be read
6002.impact: A communication update was incomplete or invalid.
steps: Check the affected connection and confirm that the app and firmware versions match.
If the problem continues, open Details and save the session log.

6003.title: A complete joint position update was not received
6003.impact: A communication update was incomplete or invalid.
steps: Check the affected connection and confirm that the app and firmware versions match.
If the problem continues, open Details and save the session log.

6004.title: A complete touch sensor update was not received
6004.impact: A communication update was incomplete or invalid.
steps: Check the affected connection and confirm that the app and firmware versions match.
If the problem continues, open Details and save the session log.

6005.title: The controller could not read an app command
6005.impact: A communication update was incomplete or invalid.
steps: Check the affected connection and confirm that the app and firmware versions match.
If the problem continues, open Details and save the session log.

8001.title: Some older diagnostic events were overwritten
8001.impact: The available event history is incomplete; this does not by itself indicate a motor fault.
steps: Save the current session log.
Check Details for a frequently repeated issue.

8002.title: The controller could not create an internal message channel
8002.impact: The controller reported an internal problem.
steps: Stop using motion controls and open Details.
When the hand is safe, restart the controller and reconnect.
If it happens again, save the session log for support.

8003.title: The controller could not create an internal lock
8003.impact: The controller reported an internal problem.
steps: Stop using motion controls and open Details.
When the hand is safe, restart the controller and reconnect.
If it happens again, save the session log for support.

8004.title: An essential controller task could not start
8004.impact: The controller reported an internal problem.
steps: Stop using motion controls and open Details.
When the hand is safe, restart the controller and reconnect.
If it happens again, save the session log for support.

8005.title: A controller task is repeatedly running late
8005.impact: Controller timing or memory headroom needs inspection.
steps: If this repeats during movement, click Stop.
Save the session log and Task Runtime details for support.

8006.title: A controller task is running low on working memory
8006.impact: Controller timing or memory headroom needs inspection.
steps: If this repeats during movement, click Stop.
Save the session log and Task Runtime details for support.

HOST_CONNECTION_LOST.title: The app is not receiving current device data
steps: Check the USB connection and controller power.
Click Connect and wait for current device data.

HOST_ELECTRICS_CAN.title: No joint position data is arriving over CAN
HOST_ELECTRICS_CAN.impact: The app cannot read the magnetic encoders while the CAN link or its wiring is down.
steps: Check CANH and CANL between S3 and P4 for swapped, open, or loose wires.
Check the common ground and the 120 ohm terminations at both ends.
Check that both CAN transceivers are powered and not in standby (STB tied low).
Check that the S3 board is powered.

HOST_ENCODER_WIRING.title: A magnetic encoder is not reporting a valid position
HOST_ENCODER_WIRING.impact: The affected joint has no usable raw feedback even though CAN is working.
steps: Check the finger connector, the sensor board power, and the magnet on the affected joint.
Check the shared MISO/SCLK/MOSI wires for the affected finger.
Open Diagnostics for the per-joint raw and latched encoder error code.

HOST_PARAMETERS_PENDING.title: Control parameters have not been applied yet
HOST_PARAMETERS_PENDING.impact: Wait for parameter synchronization before starting calibration or control.
steps: Open Control Parameters and wait for Applied.
If synchronization failed, open Details and correct the reported parameter.

HOST_PARAMETERS_INVALID.title: Some control parameters are not valid
HOST_PARAMETERS_INVALID.impact: The controller cannot use this parameter set.
steps: Open Control Parameters and correct the field shown in Details, or use Restore Defaults.
Apply the parameters before continuing.

HOST_SELECTION_EMPTY.title: Select joints or motors first
HOST_SELECTION_EMPTY.impact: The action has no selected channels.
steps: Select the channels you want to use, then repeat the action.

HOST_OPERATION_BUSY.title: Another action is still finishing
HOST_OPERATION_BUSY.impact: The app cannot start this action yet.
steps: Wait for the current action to finish.
To cancel it, use Stop; clear the resulting stop before enabling again.

HOST_RESULT_UNKNOWN.title: The app could not confirm the action result
HOST_RESULT_UNKNOWN.impact: The action may have reached the controller. Its completion is not confirmed.
steps: Wait for current device status or reconnect.
Review the returned result in Details before starting the action again.

HOST_RESULT_PARTIAL.title: Only part of the action completed
HOST_RESULT_PARTIAL.impact: Some channels completed the action; others did not.
steps: Open Details to check the completed and failed channels.
Resolve the reported cause before repeating the action.

HOST_FIRMWARE_MISMATCH.title: The app and device versions do not match
HOST_FIRMWARE_MISMATCH.impact: This connection cannot be used for control yet.
steps: Install matching app and controller firmware versions.
Reconnect and wait for the version check to complete.

HOST_MANUAL_INVALID.title: The Manual endpoints could not be used
HOST_MANUAL_INVALID.impact: The entered or captured joint endpoints are not valid.
steps: Open Joint Calibration and check the affected joint's Min and Max.
Capture valid endpoints in the indicated direction and save them.

HOST_TARGET_INVALID.title: The requested movement is outside the allowed range
HOST_TARGET_INVALID.impact: The requested target could not be used as entered.
steps: Choose a target within the range shown for the selected joint or motor.
Check calibration if the displayed range looks incorrect.

HOST_ACTION_FAILED.title: The app could not complete this action
HOST_ACTION_FAILED.impact: The exact cause is not confirmed by the available result.
steps: Open Details for the original device response.
Save the session log if the problem continues.

HOST_ABS_REBASE_FAILED.title: Motor position reset did not complete
HOST_ABS_REBASE_FAILED.impact: The controller reported that position reset failed. The specific cause is not confirmed.
steps: Open Details to identify the affected motors.
Check current motor status before repeating the reset.

HOST_CALIBRATION_FAILED.title: Calibration did not complete
HOST_CALIBRATION_FAILED.impact: The affected joints are not confirmed calibrated.
steps: Open Details for the failed phase and affected channels.
Correct the reported cause, then calibrate the affected joints.

HOST_CANCELLED.title: The action was cancelled
HOST_CANCELLED.impact: The action ended before completion; earlier completed steps may remain applied.
steps: Check the current device state before starting the intended action again.

HOST_QUALITY_WARNING.title: Calibration found a possible assembly issue
HOST_QUALITY_WARNING.impact: A quality warning was reported; the mechanical cause has not been measured.
steps: Check the affected joint, tendon routing, and preload.
Open Details for the measured result before recalibrating.

HOST_CALIB_1.title: Calibration stopped: no joints are selected
HOST_CALIB_1.impact: This action needs at least one selected joint.
steps: Select the joints you want to use, then retry the action.

HOST_CALIB_5.title: Calibration stopped: joint feedback is unavailable
HOST_CALIB_5.impact: The controller cannot use the affected joint position readings.
steps: Check the S3 sensor board and its power and CAN connections.
Wait for current joint readings to return before enabling control.

HOST_CALIB_6.title: Calibration stopped: motor locations are not known yet
HOST_CALIB_6.impact: Reliable feedback is needed before these motors can be controlled.
steps: Check motor power and the affected bus connections.
Wait for the affected motors to show Online, then retry the original action.

HOST_CALIB_8.title: Calibration stopped: a motor load safety limit was reached
steps: Check for an obstruction, a tight tendon, or a joint that cannot move freely.
After correcting the cause, retry the original action.

HOST_CALIB_13.title: Calibration stopped: the zero position could not be estimated
HOST_CALIB_13.impact: The recorded positions cannot produce a valid calibration.
steps: Check the calibration start pose and magnetic encoder installation.
Check tendon routing and preload, then calibrate the affected joint again.

HOST_CALIB_14.title: Calibration stopped: the encoder travelled nearly a full turn
HOST_CALIB_14.impact: The measured encoder travel cannot be used safely.
steps: Check the encoder and magnet mounting and watch whether the live reading follows the joint.
Check the motor mapping and saved motor position before recalibrating.

HOST_CALIB_15.title: Calibration stopped: a requested motor position is outside the safe range
HOST_CALIB_15.impact: The requested motor target was not accepted because it exceeded a safe position boundary.
steps: Check the requested target angle and the affected joint.
If ordinary targets keep reaching this limit, check calibration before continuing.

HOST_CALIB_16.title: Calibration stopped: the motor command could not be used
HOST_CALIB_16.impact: A calibration motor target was not accepted.
steps: Open Details to check the target rejection or control ownership.
Wait for the current mode change to finish; if Stop is active, check the hand and retry calibration.

HOST_CALIB_17.title: Calibration stopped: position feedback was lost
HOST_CALIB_17.impact: The app could no longer confirm all required motor and joint positions.
steps: Check live motor positions and joint encoder readings for the affected joints.
Check power and connections for the board or motors whose readings stopped.
Wait for reliable feedback before starting calibration again.

HOST_CALIB_18.title: Calibration stopped: the motor command could not be used
HOST_CALIB_18.impact: The controller reported an internal problem.
steps: Stop using motion controls and open Details.
When the hand is safe, restart the controller and reconnect.
If it happens again, save the session log for support.

HOST_CALIB_20.title: Calibration stopped: another task controls the motors
HOST_CALIB_20.impact: The controller did not accept this request in its current state.
steps: Wait for the current action or mode change to finish.
If the app remains busy, click Stop, then retry Enable.

HOST_CALIB_21.title: Calibration stopped: other joints could not be held safely
HOST_CALIB_21.impact: The controller could not hold the other selected joints during calibration.
steps: Check the affected motors are Online and their positions are known.
Open Details to identify the affected motors and check their power and bus connections.

HOST_CALIB_22.title: Calibration stopped: the joint selection could not be used
HOST_CALIB_22.impact: The requested calibration joint list was invalid.
steps: Select the required joints again.
If this repeats, save the session log for support.

HOST_CALIB_23.title: Calibration stopped: a joint was listed twice
HOST_CALIB_23.impact: The calibration sequence was rejected before it could run correctly.
steps: Select the joints again.
If this repeats, save the session log for support.

HOST_CALIB_24.title: Calibration stopped: the required starting pose was not reached
HOST_CALIB_24.impact: The helper joint could not reach the pose needed for this calibration.
steps: Check the helper joint and its motors in Details.
Check for an obstruction, tendon binding, or missing motor feedback before retrying calibration.

HOST_CALIB_25.title: Calibration stopped: a joint did not complete its calibration
HOST_CALIB_25.impact: No specific mechanical cause was reported for this failure.
steps: Check the failed joints and preceding messages in Details.
Correct the reported problem before calibrating those joints again.

HOST_CALIB_26.title: Calibration stopped: motor recovery did not finish
HOST_CALIB_26.impact: Reliable motor feedback and trusted positions were not recovered in time.
steps: Open Details to identify the unresolved motors.
Check those motors show Online and their live positions update.
Check motor power and bus connections before calibrating again.

HOST_CALIB_27.title: Calibration stopped: the tendon was released by more than two turns
HOST_CALIB_27.impact: The release limit was reached before the required joint motion was confirmed.
steps: Check for a loose, detached or broken tendon.
Check the winding direction and whether live encoder readings follow joint movement before recalibrating.

HOST_CALIB_28.title: Calibration stopped: the joint-to-motor mapping is invalid
HOST_CALIB_28.impact: The app cannot determine which motors should move this joint.
steps: Stop using motion controls.
Verify the configured joint and motor mapping with support before calibrating again.

HOST_CALIB_29.title: Calibration stopped: the measured joint travel is invalid
HOST_CALIB_29.impact: The encoder travel was too small, too large, or inconsistent for calibration.
steps: Check the joint endpoints, encoder and magnet mounting.
Watch whether live encoder readings follow the joint before recalibrating.

HOST_CALIB_30.title: Calibration stopped: the samples could not form a usable calibration
HOST_CALIB_30.impact: A valid motor-to-joint mapping could not be built from the recorded samples.
steps: Check the Manual endpoints and live encoder readings.
Inspect the samples in Details and correct missing feedback before recalibrating.

HOST_CALIB_31.title: Calibration stopped: the new result could not be saved
HOST_CALIB_31.impact: The affected joint is not confirmed to have the new calibration installed.
steps: Open Details and check the returned save or device rejection message.
Keep the session log; reconnect and verify the installed calibration before continuing.

HOST_CALIB_32.title: Calibration stopped: motor positions need to be recovered
HOST_CALIB_32.impact: The controller cannot safely interpret the affected motor positions.
steps: Wait for position recovery to finish.
If recovery fails, open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

HOST_CALIB_33.title: Calibration stopped: the app could not confirm the action result
HOST_CALIB_33.impact: The action may have reached the controller. Its completion is not confirmed.
steps: Wait for current device status or reconnect.
Review the returned result in Details before starting the action again.

HOST_CALIB_34.title: Calibration stopped: the joint did not move during the tendon exchange
HOST_CALIB_34.impact: The expected joint motion was not confirmed; the cause is not yet known.
steps: Check for binding and check both tendon winding directions and preload.
Watch whether live encoder readings follow joint movement before recalibrating.

HOST_CALIB_WARNING.title: Calibration completed with an assembly warning
HOST_CALIB_WARNING.impact: Calibration results were saved, but the measured travel or return needs inspection.
steps: Open Motor Calibration and inspect the affected joints.
Check tendon routing, preload and joint or encoder installation before continuing.

HOST_MANUAL_MISSING.title: Selected joints need Manual Min and Max values
HOST_MANUAL_MISSING.impact: The selected joints are not ready for this action.
steps: Open Joint Calibration and check the selected joints' Manual Min and Max.
Open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

HOST_CALIBRATION_MISSING.title: Selected joints need calibration data
HOST_CALIBRATION_MISSING.impact: The selected joints are not ready for this action.
steps: Open Joint Calibration and check the selected joints' Manual Min and Max.
Open Motor Calibration and calibrate the affected joints.

HOST_FEEDBACK_RECOVERY_FAILED.title: Calibration could not obtain reliable motor feedback
HOST_FEEDBACK_RECOVERY_FAILED.impact: Calibration stopped before the selected motors could be prepared safely.
steps: Check the affected motors show Online and that live position readings update.
Check motor power and bus connections.
If a scan finds all motors but live feedback is still missing, save the session log for support.
